office: the Department of Immigration's passport centres in Lusaka, Ndola and Livingstone; abroad, an embassy (here Stockholm, for the Nordic and Baltic countries)

routes.label: through the embassy in Stockholm (at least 90 days)

note: The embassy in Stockholm's procedure (published May 2019): 640 kronor for a 32-page machine-readable passport and 1,040 for 48 pages, forms included; 10 years for adults and 5 under 16; at least 90 days, a minimum, so no time is modelled; passports are issued in Zambia (Lusaka, Ndola, Livingstone). The fee in Zambia isn't read.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Zambia in Stockholm, Procedure for applying for Zambian passport and travel document of identity (May 2019)
sources.said: N.B: Zambian Passports are Issued in Zambia at the ... Lusaka - Ndola – Livingstone ... (a) 32 Pages machine readable Passport SEK640 (b) 48 Pages machine readable Passport SEK1,040 ... The cost of Passport forms is included in the application fees. ... The validity of new Passports for Adults is Ten (10) years and Five (5) for persons below the age of 16. ... Note: It will take a minimum of Ninety (90) days to process new Passports
